title: Selecting the operating mode with the rotary switch
body_md: The position of the operating mode switch activates the functions described below. The outputs can be controlled in every operating mode.
prev_context: The connection legend ends on the previous page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 9: equivalent in substance. At this point both versions refer to the section on position enquiry although output control is described elsewhere; the reference is therefore wrong in both versions (DSC-028, DSC-040) and is not reproduced here.
